output.summary: The win-rate fall is mainly a mix and measurement artifact. From 2026-04-15 the MQL threshold dropped to 40 and opportunities began auto-creating. Auto-close then filled the pipeline with 40-59 band opportunities that win 3.3% (61% of their losses were auto-closed). Excluding that band, the Q3 win rate is 29.4% against 31% in Q1. The complacency story is contradicted: rep activity is up, and non-marketing win rate is stable. Compensation is contradicted: pay is up 3% and attrition is flat. Brannock's price cut is contradicted by flat non-marketing win rates in the affected regions. Slower response on high-score leads is real but confounded by the quote-requested flag. Whether LeadSpring leads are intrinsically worse is unknown. Re-baseline reporting and re-route low-score leads. Do not run accountability plans or terminate the vendor yet.
